content.comment_body: Hi, I'm new to this program and I want to measure voltage in the 0 to 10V range. I need to be able to select between three ranges: 0 to 0.1V, 0 to 1V, and 0 to 10V. I understand this might require one analog output and three analog amplifiers with respective range settings. Ultimately, I need four outputs to indicate a binary code. Could anyone assist me with this setup?

Using three separate amplifiers won’t help here. The issue is that [product_name] only supports 0-10V voltage signals. If you want [product_name] to evaluate a signal from 0 to 0.1V, that represents just 1% of the whole range that [product_name] can process, which is less than its error margin. To accurately work with these three ranges using [product_name], you’ll need external circuitry that adjusts the lower ranges to fit within the 0-10V input.
